luiskr.com

luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/comet / makeComet

function makeComet(THREE, def, texMap, glowTex): object

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/comet.ts:239

Builds the comet composite: an irregular, nearly-black nucleus (the real Halley albedo is ~0.04 — one of the darkest known bodies), a soft additive coma sprite hugging it, and the ion + dust particle tails. The nucleus mesh becomes the node's mesh/spinner so it tumbles normally; coma rides inside it (a symmetric billboard is indifferent to spin); the tails mount on center where local +x is permanently anti-sunward. Each tail is two particle layers — a tight bright core stream and a wide dim sheath — so the column reads as a volume of gas with a dense spine, not a painted band.

Parameters

THREE

__module

The three.js module.

def

SFBodyDef

Catalog entry — radius sizes the nucleus AND every tail dimension (length, spread, grain size all scale off it); ecc/orbit drive the periapsis→apoapsis gating in updateFx.

texMap

Map<string, Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap>>

Loaded texture map (a comet with a real nucleus map uses it; Halley falls back to the seeded dark-ice surface).

glowTex

Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap> | undefined

Shared radial-glow texture — used for the coma sprite AND as each tail particle's soft round map.

Returns

object

{ mesh, coma, ion, dust, ionGas, dustGas } — the pickable nucleus group, the coma sprite, and the four Points tail layers the caller mounts on center and records on node.comet (ion/ionGas = core+sheath of the ion stream; dust/dustGas likewise).
